note: Set A contains several clear misreads and invented support: it reports 1'-4" as "1 ft" and 2'-4 1/2" as "2 ft", cites a quote "1/4\" V" for a weld size that does not appear in the text layer, and binds 6 7/8" to "Detail B" (a callout marker) and to "grid B". Set B keeps the drawn values verbatim and correctly captures the detail scale, section designations (C3X6, L3X3X1/4, L4X4X5/16, PL5X3/8) and typical 1/4" plate thickness, though it too has a few weak bindings (e.g., 10" as C3X6 "depth", a duplicated HSS keynote with a garbled quote, and a misquoted "TYP 1/4"). Set A does capture useful title-block/revision facts (copyright, checked by, revision dates) that B omits, but its outright errors are more numerous and more damaging. Overall B is the more faithful set.
